svg.title: Four photostabilizers
svg.desc: Structures of 2-hydroxy-4-methoxybenzophenone, 2-(2H-benzotriazol-2-yl)-4-methylphenol, bis(2,2,6,6-tetramethyl-4-piperidyl) sebacate and nickel bis(dibutyldithiocarbamate).
svg.text: Photostabilizers: UV absorbers, HALS and quencher
HALS: scavenges radicals via nitroxyl (N–O•) cycle
(4 CH3 on each ring; N–H hindered amine)
